messages.subject: Switching from SPSS to R - Free livestreaming seminar
parts:
Hi everyone

Instats is pleased to be offering a free 2-hour workshop on Switching from SPSS to R, running Nov 5, with Dr Daisung Jang. The transition from SPSS to R is a significant step for researchers across the social, health, and other sciences. With its open-source nature and extensive range of packages, R offers a more flexible and powerful environment for data analysis compared to SPSS. This workshop is designed to show researchers the benefits of R and to start them on their journey. By attending this workshop, participants will gain the insights necessary to leverage R's capabilities for their research projects, enhancing both the quality and efficiency of their data analysis.

Sign up today to secure your spot in this unique free event!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
